_comment: Modules the oracle decision path imports from OUTSIDE this repository.
Before task #19 these resolved through hard-coded absolute paths in
two of them into a gitignored tmp/ tree and two into a local-only agent worktree branch.
A clean clone therefore could not reconstruct the certified H12 champion.
The copies here are byte-identical to what the sealed H12 run actually imported;
every sha256 below is the value recorded in the sealed runtime manifest
tools/repro_bootstrap.py loads these by explicit path and registers them in
sys.modules, so oracle_arm's absolute sys.path entries can neither be required
nor win. Do not edit these files: an edit silently decertifies the champion.
fast_rtl_x / fast_sim_x are NOT vendored here - identical content was already
tracked at experiments/depth4/snap/, so the bootstrap pins that existing copy.

Two sections: 'modules' = files that existed ONLY outside git and are now vendored here; 'pinned_repo_modules' = files already tracked here that must be pinned because a hard-coded absolute path would otherwise capture them from a sibling worktree.

fb.origin_git: NEVER TRACKED (dr_mario_rl/.gitignore:19 'tmp/'); this vendored copy is now the authority

nes_pills.origin_git: NEVER TRACKED (dr_mario_rl/.gitignore:19 'tmp/'); this vendored copy is now the authority
nes_pills.warning: experiments/nes_pills.py is a DIFFERENT, older module with the same name. The sealed run imported THIS one; oracle_arm.py's own docstring documents the import race. The bootstrap resolves it deterministically.

drmario.faithful_env.origin_git: matches origin/worktree-faithful-sim (d5788fc6) at time of vendoring

drmario.faithful_game.origin: struktured-labs/dr_mario_rl, src/drmario/faithful_game.py, local commit 7ec4d5e on worktree-faithful-sim
drmario.faithful_game.origin_git: NOT PUSHED. origin/worktree-faithful-sim (d5788fc6) carries a DIFFERENT faithful_game.py (sha256 068869cc710b7ad23b1b9f79ea05dc6d085e1575fad9b6e1b1e460487009a243). Cloning dr_mario_rl from GitHub reproduces the WRONG file. This vendored copy is the only reachable authority.

dr_lulu_fit.note: Was untracked in all four worktrees. Resolved repo-relative by p0_ab.LULU_FIT, so tracking it is the whole fix. 2046 bytes of aggregate gameplay statistics - no personal data, no credentials.

package_support._comment: drmario/__init__.py imports .env which imports .game, so those are vendored too. controller/models/planner/ppo/replay/visualizer/faithful_policy/faithful_viz come along from the same tree for completeness and are not on the oracle import path.
